criteria.h_injectivity: x in T0 -> L(x)+B_F(x,a+e0) injective for every a in T0

formal_relation.conclusion: The H-equivalence criterion is the common-trace-factor specialization of the symmetric all-direction polar-kernel criterion. The general low-rank update lemma extends the setup to arbitrary quadratic Boolean kernels and coefficient rank r, while no priority is claimed for the hyperplane case.
formal_relation.trace_one_direction: For d with Tr(d)=1, every coset modulo <d> has a unique trace-zero representative x; the perturbed polar kernel condition becomes B_F(d,x)+L(x)=0.
formal_relation.trace_zero_direction: For d with Tr(d)=0, an extra kernel vector must have trace one and satisfies B_F(d,x)+L(d)=0. By symmetry B_F(d,x)=B_F(x,d), this is the H-injectivity test for the trace-one direction x evaluated at d in T0.
